facts_of_case: Appellant filed divorce petition under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act. Trial court dismissed the petition. Appellant appealed and also applied for maintenance pendente lite and litigation expenses.

legal_principles.principle: The defence is to be struck off if the order passed under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act for the grant of maintenance pendente lite is not complied with.
legal_principles.held: I he effect of non-compliance of the order passed on the application under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act for the grant of maintenance pendente lite is that the defence is to be struck off.

legal_principles.principle: A spouse is liable to pay litigation expenses and maintenance allowance throughout the litigation proceedings if an application is filed under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act.
legal_principles.held: In view of the clear provision contained in the Act, I am of the firm view that the husband is liable to pay litigation expenses and maintenance allowance throughout the litigation proceedings.

outcome.final_order: Husband's defence struck off due to non-compliance with court order regarding payment of maintenance pendente lite and litigation expenses.
